docDescription: Software engineer and tech lead. Over ten years of getting software into production and keeping it there.
taglineBefore: I build software, fix what breaks and, now and then,
heroLead: Over ten years of getting software into production. And, the harder part, keeping it there.
aboutLede: I like understanding how things work, and why they stopped working.
aboutBody: I’ve worked across code, databases, infrastructure and project management, so I don’t mind much where a problem lives. What I care about is fixing it properly, in a way the next person (often me) can follow.

pillars.label: BUILD
pillars.text: Applications and databases built to last, not just to demo.

pillars.label: SOLVE
pillars.text: Troubleshooting, integrations and performance, especially when nobody’s sure where to start.

pillars.label: DELIVER
pillars.text: Coordinating teams and talking to clients, so what ships is what they actually needed.

projectsLead: Some built for clients, some just because.
galleryLead: It’s all here, including what didn’t fit on the home page.

projects.title: Imóveis Ana Morgado
projects.caption: SCREENSHOT / IMÓVEIS ANA MORGADO
projects.alt: Home page of the Imóveis Ana Morgado website, with Ana’s photo, a button to explore listings and her years of experience and homes sold.
projects.summary: Ana’s website. She’s an independent estate agent, and clients can browse her listings, search by area and price and contact her directly.

projects.title: Évora Serviços
projects.caption: SCREENSHOT / ÉVORA SERVIÇOS
projects.alt: Évora Serviços banner with the Roman Temple of Évora and the tagline “A sua cidade. Os melhores serviços.”
projects.summary: In Évora, finding a good plumber still meant asking the neighbours. I built a platform where residents find local services and businesses get found without a website of their own.

projects.title: McGill University — Oracle Forms to Java
projects.caption: DIAGRAM / MIGRATION PATH
projects.alt: A person typing code on a laptop in an empty classroom.
projects.summary: A large-scale move of McGill’s legacy Oracle Forms systems to a modern Java architecture. I set the migration strategy, lead the team and am the client’s main point of contact.

projects.title: ACU — Oracle Forms to Java migration
projects.caption: DIAGRAM / FORMS TO JAVA
projects.alt: A blueprint-style diagram of legacy Oracle Forms modules being migrated into a Java application.
projects.summary: Legacy Oracle Forms modules rebuilt as a Java application. I led the development team and made the technical calls from migration through delivery.

projects.title: Infrastructure Redesign
projects.caption: DIAGRAM / DBA
projects.alt: Wooden letter tiles spelling DATA on a table.
projects.summary: A shared database environment was getting harder to maintain with every new client. I redesigned it around dedicated instances per client on open-source Linux, supporting Oracle 11 through 19.
projects.result: Every client in its own space, every Oracle version supported

projects.title: Personal page
projects.caption: SCREENSHOT / PERSONAL PAGE
projects.alt: The top of this site: “Hi, I’m José.” beside a blueprint schematic linking code, data, infra, delivery and people.
projects.summary: This site. Bilingual, drawn like a blueprint, built with Next.js.

projects.title: Travel map
projects.caption: SCREENSHOT / TRAVEL MAP
projects.alt: The Travel Map app showing Europe and North Africa, with a sidebar for searching and filtering places.
projects.summary: A map to mark where I’ve been and where I want to go, filter by country and year, and export a poster for the wall. Data stays in your browser, so export the JSON now and then.
projects.result: English and Portuguese, dark mode, no account

timeline.title: Technical Lead / Delivery Coordinator / Scrum Master
timeline.summary: I lead a large Oracle Forms-to-Java modernisation programme end to end: planning, technical strategy and Agile delivery. I’m the client’s main point of contact, and I run sprint planning and release scheduling for a cross-functional team.

timeline.title: Database Administrator
timeline.summary: Oracle and PostgreSQL for enterprise clients: installing, configuring and keeping production and test environments reliable. When something breaks under pressure, I find the cause and fix it before it hits the client’s SLA.

timeline.title: DevOps / Release & Delivery Management
timeline.summary: I coordinate release and delivery cycles for several client projects at once, from getting environments ready to deployment, working with development, QA and support so every release goes out as planned.

timeline.title: Application Support Developer
timeline.summary: Support for projects already delivered: tracking down issues and keeping systems stable and clients happy.

timeline.title: Java Application Developer – Migration
timeline.summary: Where it all started: migrating legacy Oracle Forms applications to Java for international clients’ modernisation projects.

trainingLead: Teaching is part of the job too.

training.label: DEVELOPERS TRAINED
training.title: Technical trainer, global
training.text: Three-to-five-day programmes on Java best practices and Agile modernisation for client and internal teams in Bangalore, Sydney, Boston and remotely.

training.label: NEW HIRES ONBOARDED
training.title: Internal technical trainer
training.text: Week-long onboarding for new hires and interns: the company’s technologies, development standards and engineering practices.

training.label: ÉVORA
training.title: Community co-organiser
training.text: I help run Google Developer Group Évora, planning talks, workshops and meetups so local developers can share what they know.

notesTitle: Things I’ve picked up along the way.

notes.text: Most problems are simpler than they look.
A good log saves hours of guessing.

contactLead: Whether it’s a new project, an opportunity or that bug nobody can pin down, drop me a line. I always reply.
